prompt: Write a blog post on machine learning workflow, give all details like bringing data from resources  data ingestion various data formats various databases and terminoology involved
response: The machine learning workflow involves several steps, including data collection, data preparation, data ingestion, data storage, and data analysis. The data collection step involves gathering raw data from various sources, such as sensors or user-provided data. The data preparation step involves cleaning and transforming the data to meet the requirements of the machine learning model. The data ingestion step involves sending the prepared data to the data storage system. The data storage step involves storing the data in a format that can be easily processed by the machine learning model. The data analysis step involves using the machine learning model to extract insights from the data.
